The villa of your dreams: 5,000 sqm of parkland, pool, and outdoor SPA on the outskirts of Jesolo. Simply fantastic. Monumental spaces, absolute privacy, and the luxury of a private home SPA. This extraordinary villa is a masterpiece of comfort and style. What makes it unique: The Park: 5,000 m² of private parkland—a green oasis perfect for outdoor events or letting children play while enjoying maximum privacy. The Pool Area: A scenic eight by four-meter pool with equipped sunbathing area—the centerpiece of your summer days and sunset aperitifs. The Outdoor SPA: A spectacular external sauna for 10 people combined with a hot tub provides total relaxation experience all year round. Inside the villa constantly interacts with the outside thanks to large windows that flood rooms with natural light. Inside, the villa reveals its magnificence with impeccable elegant space distribution. At the heart of this home lies an enormous spectacular open space featuring living room and kitchen—an impressive environment flooded with light from large windows framing the park; perfect for welcoming guests or enjoying family time in a fluid contemporary atmosphere. Adding unmistakable warmth to this space is magnificent original terracotta flooring that perfectly complements breathtaking exposed beams overhead made from expertly reclaimed original rafters and tiles—all surrounded by architectural elements that showcase undoubtedly unique refined taste. The sleeping area has been designed to ensure utmost comfort & privacy offering four spacious bedrooms along three refined bathrooms fitted out in high-quality finishes—a fantastic residence where internal space harmonizes seamlessly with exterior luxury! A wonderful property ready to welcome your most beautiful moments!
